scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (IS)
other_conditions: Must be a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise
Must belong to the manufacturing sector
Must have started production on or after 1st April 2019
Must be in the private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector undertaking, or a company/undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or Industrial SHGs
Date of Commencement of Commercial Production (DOCCP) must be between 1st April 2020 and 31st March 2025
Application must be submitted within 12 months from the DOCCP or within 12 months from the date of notification of Banglashree, whichever is later
benefits_summary: Interest subsidy on the annual interest liability of term loans for up to five years, with subsidy rates of 55% or 70% for micro and small enterprises and 25% for medium enterprises (capped at ₹1.75 crore per year).
